case_assignment_source: Each workflow row in the workflow contract carries foundation_case_ids, academy_case_ids, iar_case_ids and integrated_case_ids; validation requires exact-once coverage across all inherited and new cases.
assertions: All eighteen teaching surfaces and all nine governed roles are exercised by at least one integrated workflow.
All thirty Foundation cases, twenty GM Academy cases, forty Teaching Library IAR cases and thirty-six integrated workflow cases are assigned to exactly one workflow.
Every one of the eighteen projection groups, thirty governed actions and thirteen authority handoffs appears in at least one workflow.
All persisted teaching writes use P13-MUT-001 with authorization, expected_version and operation_id; ambiguous outcomes resolve by operation status before retry.
Permission and minimum-field filtering occur before discovery, search, counts, ranking, autocomplete, examples, tutorial branches, diagnostics, export, notifications and optional AI context.
GM Academy remains optional and non-gating; developed-source craft cannot override canonical Multiversal mechanics or feature authority.
Multiversal Academy outline headings become factual lessons only when canonical grounding exists; unsupported headings remain explicit gaps.
Tutorial-Campaign and World Creation output remain synthetic/noncanonical; Pack lifecycle teaching preserves P13-GAP-001 instead of inventing F024 behavior.
PPIA-14 retains final error/recovery/permission microcopy; PPIA-13 owns concept teaching and safe handoff categories only.
Mobile, keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion, noncolor and zero-AI paths preserve equivalent required meaning and actions.
No workflow activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid services or production credentials.
